title: Ribbitveil Custom Items Resource Pack
description: A Resource Pack used along with the Custom Roleplay Data Datapack to recreate the custom items found in the Ribbitveil SMP.
body:
![rb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12a527a3c3ae0bd98933988781ae3e711dc44832.png)

---

**The Official Resource Pack used in the Ribbitveil SMP,** now available for Public Use!!

This Resource Pack REQUIRES Custom Roleplay Data Datapack to work Server-Side. It will be determined on whether or not CIT support is added, albeit it mostly likely won't.

The pack provides a plethora of custom models, for aesthetic, practical and lore reasons, on the Ribbitveil SMP. It can be used for personal use, as well as for your own SMPs, however, you'll need to ask for permission from the Project Owner/Creator.

It still has a lot of work to be done, and generally requires quite a bit of time before considred "Done". Also, the project will be restarted when S2 of the server begins.

<details>
<summary>FAQ</summary>
  
-  **Do I need this to play on Ribbitveil?**

   > - While it's not an exact necessity, it adds on to a lot of the items in the server. Also, if you don't have it installed and you have the Analog mod, you tend to see a lot of Radios where Coins, Trophies, etc. are meant to be. If your PC cannot handle it however, you are more than welcome to not download it!

- **Can I only use this while playing on the Server?**
  
   > - Naturally, no. You can use this for personal use. However, you may not use my work for Commercial or use.


</details>
